concept.cross_view_consistency_note: Both views show one consolidated squat rose-taupe mass with sloped top, broad planes and horizontally flattened dark lenticules. Front concept has a deep offset fracture; rear varies the top outline and number of small lenses. Freeze one coherent original broad angular mass with sloped stepped top, not a field specimen copy. Preserve larger tapered lenticules as actual weathered shallow relief cavities, subordinate quiet matrix and medium/small lens rhythm. Do not reproduce concept speckled texture or its inconsistent minor fractures; no round clasts or continuous bedding stripes.
concept.hidden_surface_decisions: Author rear and both sides with sparse original flattened lenticules, closed grounded base and a quiet sloping top. Weathered differential relief is a teaching-art interpretation. Lens pockets have real depth and bounded interiors; no unbounded rock holes or loose rock scatter.
